projects.title: For Every Kind of Mother
projects.subtitle: Fertility Care App
projects.description: Many fertility clinics in South Korea turn away unmarried women. We built a shared database of clinic visit records and a website to help them find clinics willing to treat them.
projects.quote: “Some doctors may see you, while others may not. If one turns you away, try another doctor.”

images.alt: Fertility clinic finder with search results and a map
Clinic details with availability and reviews

projects.title: Adopt, Don’t Shop
projects.subtitle: Paw in Hand · Real-time Chat
projects.description: Paw in Hand helps more than 20,000 abandoned animals find homes each year. My team added real-time chat, shaped by feedback from staff, shelters, and adopters.

projects.title: A Chatbot for Nonprofits
projects.subtitle: In development · pilot
projects.description: We help nonprofits identify routine tasks to automate and make them easy to handle through a chatbot. Our Gyeongmyodang pilot streamlines volunteer sign-ups, cancellations, and roster management.

images.alt: Volunteer sign-up chat for Mango Dev on KakaoTalk
